reason: I already put my offers on the local WhatsApp group and that works fine for me. Another sign-in, another app, and teaching my counter boy a PIN during the morning rush is not something I will do for a beta.
objection: Customers won't bother showing a coupon. They walk in, order idli-vada, pay by UPI and go. Nobody is opening a link at my counter, so the counting will show zero and I will have wasted my time.
would_change_my_mind: If it worked fully on WhatsApp with no app or login, and someone from Mitra came to my shop, set it up and showed me a nearby darshini that actually got counted customers from it.
